title: Noragami Creators Return With New Manga Yadoya no Oinu-sama
description: Adachitoka, the creator duo behind Noragami, returns to Monthly Shonen Magazine with a new manga beginning October 6, 2026.
dek: Adachitoka's first new serialization after Noragami begins this October with a mysterious otherworldly story.

hero.alt: AniManga Updates with Old Man Otaku

blocks.html: After more than two years away from regular serialization, Adachitoka, the manga-creator duo behind Noragami, is returning with a brand-new series.

Yadoya no Oinu-sama will launch in the November 2026 issue of Kodansha's Monthly Shonen Magazine, which goes on sale in Japan on October 6, 2026. The announcement marks Adachitoka's first new serialization following the conclusion of Noragami in January 2024.

The newly announced story follows a middle-school student whose school trip takes a strange turn after a fall down a mountainside. The early promotional material teases her return to an extraordinary world and an encounter with a mysterious girl, leaving the larger nature of that world deliberately unexplained.

That wording gives the premise an immediate mystery: rather than presenting the setting simply as a first journey into another world, the announcement suggests the protagonist may already have some connection to it.
Adachitoka's First Major Project Since Noragami

For longtime manga readers, the creators are the biggest part of the announcement. Noragami ran for more than a decade and ultimately reached 27 collected volumes. Its popularity also led to two television anime seasons produced by BONES.

That history makes Yadoya no Oinu-sama more than another monthly serialization launch. It is the first opportunity to see what Adachitoka builds after closing the book on the supernatural series that defined much of the duo's career.

Adachitoka shared preview artwork for the new manga alongside the announcement, providing an early look at several characters and settings. RogueVerse recommends the official promotional visual for editorial coverage with the appropriate Adachitoka/Kodansha credit rather than recreated fan artwork.
When Does Yadoya no Oinu-sama Begin?

The first chapter is scheduled for October 6, 2026, when the November issue of Monthly Shonen Magazine goes on sale in Japan. No English-language release has been confirmed in the reporting available at publication time.

Creator follow-ups carry a different kind of weight. Adachitoka spent years building one of the recognizable supernatural manga franchises of the 2010s, and the initial premise of Yadoya no Oinu-sama suggests the duo is not simply rebuilding Yato's world under another name. A young protagonist, a mysterious return to an extraordinary world and an unexplained encounter give the new series room to establish its own identity.
RogueVerse take: after a run as long as Noragami, seeing what Adachitoka chooses to build next is reason enough to put this October launch on the watchlist.
